members.name: value
members.doc: The selected range as YYYY-MM-DD start and end dates, when the caller controls it. null keeps a controlled calendar empty. A string that is not a valid date throws a TypeError.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting selected range, when the calendar controls itself.

members.name: focusedValue
members.doc: The focused date as YYYY-MM-DD, when the caller controls it. It is separate from the selected range, and controlling it also controls the month shown. Moving focus does not select.

members.name: minValue
members.doc: The earliest date, inclusive, that can be focused or selected.

members.name: maxValue
members.doc: The latest date, inclusive, that can be focused or selected.

members.name: unavailableDateMatcher
members.doc: Returns true for a date that is unavailable, given as a YYYY-MM-DD string. An unavailable date can take focus but cannot be selected.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the range the user selects, as YYYY-MM-DD start and end dates, once both are chosen. It is not called while the calendar is disabled or read-only.

members.name: onFocusChange
members.doc: Called with the focused date as YYYY-MM-DD when focus moves to another date, by the arrow keys or the month buttons. It is not called while the calendar is disabled.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the calendar: no date can be focused or selected.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the calendar read-only: focus still moves between dates, but selecting a range does nothing.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the calendar required. It currently has no effect on a calendar, which submits no form value.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Forces the invalid state when true. Left false, validation follows the selected range, so the calendar is still invalid when either endpoint is before minValue, after maxValue, or marked unavailable. Dates between the endpoints are not checked.

types.name: RangeCalendarOwnProps

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the calendar. Without one, the calendar needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.
